about.title: About Us
about.intro: Founded in 2004, Ergen Tekstil is a global manufacturer of numerous private-label apparel products. Headquartered in Istanbul, the company produces for many brands across the European, African and Asian markets.
about.missionText: Ergen Tekstil was founded in 2004 as a company integrating knitting and garment facilities to manufacture seamless apparel. Today, with a production capacity of 200,000 pieces/month, it is one of the leading quality manufacturers in its field. Through the effective use of technology and an innovative approach, we recognize that adapting quickly to a changing world and prioritizing innovation are essential values.
about.visionText: In line with our growth targets, the construction of our own factory in the Tekirdağ Kapaklı Organized Industrial Zone is progressing rapidly. Once complete, it will both increase our capacity and bring us one step closer to our goal of expanding into new international markets. As a manufacturing brand, Ergen Tekstil aims to strengthen its position among global competitors through effective branding in production. The company continuously pursues learning and development with its dedicated team. While prioritizing sustainable production methods, we value effective communication with our business partners and foster a culture of ownership, confidence and happiness among our team members.
about.principlesTitle: The core principles that guide Ergen Tekstil are:
principles: Strengthening our team members' sense of ownership over their work.
Creating a sense of belonging and satisfaction by meeting customer needs and expectations.
Remaining committed to transparent and fair management practices in line with laws and regulations.
Prioritizing sustainable production at our green factory to fulfil our responsibility to future generations and the environment.
Embracing digitalization and efficient production methods in management and operations.
Upholding the values of sincerity, honesty and quality in all our endeavours.

process.title: Our Processes
process.intro: Seamless textile production is a method that enables the manufacture of continuous, single-piece fabrics. This production process differs from traditional sewing methods and involves a specific set of stages. Here are the core processes required for seamless textile production, from start to finish:

steps.title: Design and Development
steps.text: In the first stage, the design team creates product concepts based on customer requests and trends. Textile engineers technically evaluate these concepts and determine their manufacturability.

steps.title: Knitting Technology
steps.text: Circular knitting machines are generally used for seamless production. These machines allow for the production of single-piece fabric. Textile engineers optimize the settings and parameters of the knitting machines.

steps.title: Material Selection and Preparation
steps.text: Selecting suitable fibres and yarns is a critical step that determines product quality. Yarns must be properly prepared and fed into the knitting machines.

steps.title: Knitting Process
steps.text: Knitting machines produce the fabric as a single piece according to the designed pattern. During this process, machine operators and maintenance staff work under close supervision.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.text: The fabrics produced undergo a detailed quality control process to verify compliance with quality standards. If any defect is detected, faulty parts are corrected or rejected.

steps.title: Dyeing and Finishing
steps.text: Fabrics are dyed and finished in the desired colours and patterns. This step improves the aesthetic and functional properties of the product.

steps.title: Cutting and Seamless Manufacturing
steps.text: The fabrics produced are cut and shaped according to design requirements. For seamless production, the cut pieces are assembled or joined using special machines.

steps.title: Packaging and Distribution
steps.text: Products are appropriately packaged according to customer requirements and prepared for shipment. Optimizing logistics processes is essential at the distribution stage.

process.outro: Seamless textile production requires each of these processes to be followed meticulously and generally involves the use of modern technologies. Every step of the process matters in ensuring quality, efficiency and customer satisfaction.
process.statsText: By continuously following up-to-date technology and trends, we develop solutions tailored to our customers' needs.
